# Run from the code20260701 repository root.
# The feature matrices used below are generated by code/01_prepare_inputs.R
# from the five supplied input files under data/metadata/.

Rscript code/01_prepare_inputs.R

python code/random_forest.py \
  -i data/random_forest/fungi_features.tsv \
  -m data/metadata/sample_map_baseline.tsv \
  -o results/random_forest/fungi

python code/random_forest.py \
  -i data/random_forest/bacteria_features.tsv \
  -m data/metadata/sample_map_baseline.tsv \
  -o results/random_forest/bacteria

python code/random_forest.py \
  -i data/random_forest/merged_features.tsv \
  -m data/metadata/sample_map_baseline.tsv \
  -o results/random_forest/merged
